metadata.description: Lockstep: skills, hooks and shared checks for spec-first, test-locked development with coding agents. Installable in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: lockstep-core
plugins.description: Lockstep workflow skills for any track: set up a repo, then spec, test, implement and self-review for spec-first, test-locked work with coding agents.

plugins.name: lockstep-data
plugins.description: Lockstep skills for the data track: see what a dbt change affects, from changed models to consumers outside dbt.

plugins.name: copilot-review-instructions
plugins.description: Generate and maintain repo-specific Copilot code review instructions (.github/copilot-instructions.md and path-scoped *.instructions.md) on top of project-wide rules.
